attacks.claim: Stage 1 lasts 3 days, but installs only run in a 02:00-05:00 window and users can postpone up to 14 days. Stage 1 may therefore have few updated units when the advance gate is evaluated.
attacks.evidence: Stage 1: 1% (~6,100), 3 days; "Users can postpone an update up to 14 days from the app."
